short_description: A rapid prototype exploring abstract emotions.
description: Neon Vanguard is a fast-paced mech combat game.

content_blocks.title: Overall Game Design
content_blocks.text: Exploring the feeling of alienation, our team discovered that this sentiment is often tied to other feelings like uncertainty, fear, judgement, self-doubt or even hope. Focusing on these specific feelings, we designed an experience composed by three stages, each of which revolves around one of these feelings.

To achieve the pixelated effect I simply used a Render Texture and then displayed it in a Raw Image Canvas element. This way, we quickly achieved a retro look that made our game more visually appealing.

content_blocks.title: Custom Unlit Shader
content_blocks.text: Using Shader Graph, I created a custom unlit scrolling shader used to evoke instability and emotional tension. The shader included several parameters such as Color, Power, Speed or Tiling. This way, we were able to customize it and reuse it depending on our needs.

content_blocks.title: Level Design - Stage 2
content_blocks.text:
The second level had to convey a feeling of judgement but, at the same time, it had to create a sense of hope for the player. In order to achieve that, I had the idea to develop an AI behaviour for our NPCs (red pyramids) in a way that they would walk and whisper around you for some time, but suddenly stop to look at you in pure judgement.

To represent hope, I added a "cling" sound effect in the background, as well as some huge yellow cylinders that would also help guiding the player to the next stage of the game.

content_blocks.title: NPC_Behaviour

content_blocks.text: Our AI simply has 2 states. It switches between them every 5 seconds.

title: Alienation
contributions: This project visualizes alienation without words or traditional storytelling, guiding the player through three rooms that express different stages of the feeling through geometry and sound. I designed and built the second room, as well as different shaders, post process effects and the NPCs AI behaviour.
